I am writing to formally inform that we are moving case 0433381 ﻿from the

Unfortunately, we cannot do much remotely when we don't have SCB connection. The best would be to have someone on site to check:
kindly refer the below points which might be the reason to out the charger on SCB.
Then there might be Internet issue with the Siemens router and probably because of failover function the WAN is switched from Cellular to Ethernet.
I would recommend doing a Hard reset from "OCPP" (If charger is connected to OCPP server) or a local reboot will bring them up again.
Data service of mobile network operator might not be available.
- SIM card might be disabled / expired (Please check if the SIM card is inserted incorrectly by cleaning and then reinserting it into the XF3 and XF4 router.)
- monthly data volume exhausted
- signal strength got weak due to changed radio transmission conditions
- in case of M2M contracts is IP not enabled
It could be Teltonika related issues.
- Router switches to a wrong network service (e.g. 3G instead of 4G)
- Hardware failure of Router
- Router software crash
Carry a spare router with you.

additional_info.subject: 0433381 - ID0433381-DC/Si-D/SA-[MP / RD 170002987] OCPP URL Change request. CRM:00314000194
additional_info.body:
Dear colleagues,
I am reaching out in regards of ticket
ID0433381
for charger
170002987.
The ticket was opened for connectivity issues to the OCPP Backend, and today an onsite visit happened with the remote support from Expert.
The charger has an external router, which provides internet connection to both router XF3 (Siemens Backend) and XF4 (OCPP Backend). Both routers still had the WAN configuration set to Mobile. Once changed the WAN connection to Wired, both routers connected to Internet. The charger was then connected to the Ampeco Backend successfully.
Once restored the connectivity and closed the door, the charger configured and showed DC2 out of order. I checked remotely and noticed a communication issue between SECC KF11 and the PLC. By rebooting the charger and re-establishing the Ethernet connection between KF11 and PLC, the communication was restored, and the charger successfully configured.
The charger is now online on both SCB and Backend, and all outlets are available.
Therefore I will proceed to close this ticket
ID0433381.
If you need any further assistance, please do reach back out to us by submitting a new request at
www.siemens.com/emobility-service-request
